slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the number of trained pilots that a single fighter jet can produce in one year when it is allocated exclusively for pilot training?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked for the per-year pilot training capacity of a single training jet, directly covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or about any pilot-to-jet relationship.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are the fighter jets produced in year 1 available for training in year 1 itself, or do they only become available starting in year 2?
slot_scores.rationale: Through turns 5, 6 and 7 the agent established that training occurs in year 1 and year 2 and that pilots from both years count, effectively pinning down the training start and duration.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 slot (H1, training capacity) was explicitly confirmed and the P1 training timeline (H3) was resolved via the year-1/year-2 and summation questions. The only unasked slot is the P2 pilot-to-combat-jet mapping, which does not affect the core computation, so stopping at READY_TO_MODEL was appropriate.

summary: The agent recovered the critical training-capacity fact (H1) and the training timeline (H3) with clear targeted questions, but never probed the low-severity pilot-to-combat-jet mapping (H2); it stopped with all P0/P1 facts resolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
